title: comparison mapExt bijective
statement: For a scheme Z, a Grothendieck abelian coefficient category A in the stated size universes, etale A-sheaves X,Y and n≥0, exact etale-to-pro-etale comparison induces a bijection Ext^n(X,Y)→Ext^n(ν*X,ν*Y) [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism, def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: The bounded-below derived comparison is fully faithful: discrete injectives are acyclic for comparison direct image and the comparison adjunction unit is invertible. Its fully faithful map on Hom groups is bijective. The exact-functor Ext realization in the bounded-below derived category commutes with comparison, giving the displayed unbounded Ext map in the selected HasExt models.

theorem comparison_mapExt_bijective (Z : Scheme.{u})
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology A)]
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) A)]
    (X Y : Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology A) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (fun c : Ext.{u + 1} X Y n ↦
      Ext.mapExactFunctor.{u + 1, u + 1} (comparisonUpperStar A Z) c)
